title: Count after lightning, divide by 3: that's the km #Shorts

yt.title: Count after lightning, divide by 3: that's the km #Shorts
yt.description:
Sound travels about 343 m/s in air at 20 °C, so it covers 1 km in about 2.9 s. Light arrives almost instantly.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Next storm, count the seconds after the lightning.
The light reaches you almost instantly. The sound crawls at three hundred forty three meters per second. One kilometer takes about three seconds.

scenes.label: divide by 5 for miles
scenes.narration: So divide the seconds by three, and you get kilometers. By five for miles.
Under ten seconds, it's close enough to hit you. Get inside.
Try it on the next storm.
